name: AT-03
title: Defanged URL and punctuation changes
summary: The model was materially sensitive to punctuation and URL formatting changes, which is a limitation in the current feature space.
baseline_message: The password reset was completed and your security review is active. No further action is required and the service desk has already verified the request.
perturbed_message: URGENT!!! Your password reset is pending and the account review requires confirmation now! Please verify hxxp://secure[.]portal[.]review/login before the security check closes.
note: Model limitation: formatting changes such as URL defanging and punctuation materially shift the score, indicating surface-form sensitivity rather than robust semantic understanding.
